instruments.name: Dynamic Shear Rheometer
instruments.description: The Dynamic Shear Rheometer (DSR) measures the viscoelastic properties of bituminous binders over a range of temperatures and loading frequencies. It determines the complex shear modulus (G*) and phase angle (δ) used to evaluate rutting and fatigue characteristics as per Superpave specifications.
instruments.application: Evaluation of binder rheological properties, rutting and fatigue performance, and determination of PG grading parameters

instruments.name: Bending Beam Rheometer
instruments.description: BBR measures flexural creep stiffness and m-value of asphalt binders at low temperatures to assess thermal cracking susceptibility. It simulates binder performance under cold climatic conditions by applying a constant load on a rectangular beam submerged in a controlled temperature bath.
instruments.application: Determination of low-temperature creep stiffness and stress relaxation parameters for PG grading

instruments.name: Softening Point
instruments.description: Determines the temperature at which bitumen transitions from a semi-solid to a liquid state. This temperature reflects the binder's thermal stability and resistance to flow under elevated temperatures
instruments.application: Assessing binder consistency, temperature susceptibility, and suitability for high-temperature applications

instruments.name: Fully Automatic Penetrometer
instruments.description: Penetration Test measures the depth (in tenths of a millimeter) to which a standard needle penetrates a bituminous sample
instruments.application: Determining binder consistency and hardness for classification

instruments.name: Rotational Viscosity Test
instruments.description: Rotational Viscometer measures the viscosity of bituminous binders at mixing and compaction temperatures. It determines the workability and temperature susceptibility of asphalt binders
instruments.application: Determining viscosity-temperature relationship for binder handling, mixing, and compaction in HMA production.

instruments.name: Absolute Viscosity Test
instruments.description: Absolute Viscosity Test uses a vacuum capillary viscometer to determine the dynamic viscosity of bitumen at 60°C.
instruments.application: Quantifying binder stiffness and flow characteristics for viscosity-grade classification and quality control.

instruments.name: Surface free energy test
instruments.description: Surface Free Energy (SFE) test evaluates the adhesive and cohesive characteristics of asphalt binders using contact angle measurements. The sessile drop method quantifies surface energy components to assess binder–aggregate compatibility
instruments.application: Assessing adhesion between binder and aggregate; evaluating stripping potential and moisture damage resistance

instruments.name: Rolling Thin Film Oven
instruments.description: RTFO simulates short-term aging of asphalt binders during hot-mix production. It exposes thin films of bitumen to heat and air flow
instruments.application: Simulating short-term oxidative aging for binder property evaluation

instruments.name: Pressure Aging Vessel
instruments.description: PAV simulates long-term oxidative aging of asphalt binders to replicate field aging over several years. It subjects RTFO-aged samples to elevated temperature and pressure
instruments.application: Evaluation of long-term aging effects for binder durability

instruments.name: Ductility Test
instruments.description: Ductility Test measures the distance a bituminous sample can stretch before breaking under controlled conditions (usually 25 °C and 5 cm/min). It assesses the binder's flexibility and crack resistance.
instruments.application: Evaluating binder elongation capacity and tensile strain tolerance at intermediate service temperatures.

instruments.name: Superpave Gyratory Compactor
instruments.description: Superpave Gyratory Compactor is used to compact asphalt mixtures under controlled pressure, angle, and gyration rate to simulate field compaction.
instruments.application: Compaction of asphalt specimens for Superpave mix design and performance evaluation

instruments.name: Marshall Compactor
instruments.description: Marshall Compactor prepares cylindrical asphalt specimens by applying a specified number of blows to each side using a standard hammer. It is used in the Marshall mix design method
instruments.application: Preparation of asphalt specimens

instruments.name: CoreLok
instruments.description: The CoreLok system is a vacuum chamber that is used with specially designed polymer bags to completely seal field and laboratory asphalt samples from water during the specific gravity measurements.
instruments.application: This device can be used for determination of bulk gravity of compacted asphalt samples, maximum gravity of loose asphalt samples, porosity or permeability of compacted field or laboratory samples, and gravity and absorption of fine and coarse aggregates.

instruments.name: Auto Rice Apparatus (Gmm)
instruments.description: The AutoRice is an automatic control unit designed to improve accuracy and repeatability of the maximum specific gravity test (AASHTO T-209, Rice Test/Gmm) for asphalt mixtures.
instruments.application: The Gmm is used to calculate the percent air voids or relative density (Gmb), which is critical for mixture design, pavement quality control and laboratory mixture performance testing.

instruments.name: Asphalt Mixture Performance Tester (AMPT)
instruments.description: The Asphalt Mixture Performance Tester (AMPT) was used for the determination of mixture performance under dynamic and static conditions at varying temperatures.
instruments.application: AMPT was used for the determination of mixture performance in terms of cracking and rutting under dynamic and static conditions at varying temperatures. It is also used for the determination modulus (Resilient and Dynamic Modulus) of the hot/cold mix asphalt.

instruments.name: Hamburg Wheel Tracking Test
instruments.description: Measures the rutting and moisture susceptibility of asphalt mixtures under repeated loading of a steel wheel
instruments.application: Evaluating rutting resistance and stripping potential of asphalt mixtures.

instruments.name: Universal Testing Machine
instruments.modelNumber: Testing Setup- B220P112 Pnumatic Controler- B270-12
instruments.description: Universal Testing Machine (UTM) was used for the determination of mixture performance and for the determination of the modulus of the asphalt mixture.
instruments.application: Universal Testing Machine (UTM) was used for the determination of mixture performance in terms of cracking, rutting and for the determination of the modulus (Resilient modulus) of the asphalt mixture.

instruments.name: Wirtgen Laboratory Foamed Bitumen Plant
instruments.description: The Wirtgen Laboratory Foamed Bitumen Plant is used for the generation of foamed bitumen.
instruments.application: The Wirtgen Laboratory Foamed Bitumen Plant is used for the generation of foamed bitumen, which will be helpful for the preparation of cold recycled mixes.

instruments.name: Aggregate Impact Value Test
instruments.manufacturer: M/s. Lawrence & Mayo Pvt. Ltd. Bombay
instruments.description: AIV test determines the aggregate's resistance to sudden impact or shock by measuring the percentage of fines generated after a series of hammer blows
instruments.application: Assessing aggregate toughness and suitability for pavement construction.

instruments.name: Aggregate Image Measurement System
instruments.description: Aggregate Image Measurement System (AIMS) is an advanced optical device used to automatically quantify aggregate shape characteristics, including angularity, texture, sphericity, and flatness. It utilizes digital image processing and laser-based 3D surface scanning to evaluate both coarse and fine aggregates.
instruments.application: Determining aggregate shape and surface characteristics

instruments.name: Polished Stone Value Test
instruments.description: Polished Stone Value (PSV) test measures the resistance of aggregates to polishing under simulated traffic conditions using the accelerated polishing machine.
instruments.application: Evaluating aggregate skid resistance and surface friction properties for pavement safety.

instruments.name: British Pendulum Skid Resistance Test
instruments.description: British Pendulum Tester measures the skid resistance or frictional properties of aggregates and pavement surfaces. A rubber slider attached to a swinging arm is released from a fixed height, and the energy loss due to surface friction is measured on a calibrated scale.
instruments.application: Evaluating skid resistance and surface friction characteristics of aggregates, asphalt, and concrete pavements

instruments.name: Micro-Deval Abrasion Test
instruments.description: The Micro-Deval apparatus is a modern, safety-enhanced testing machine designed to evaluate the abrasion resistance and durability of fine and coarse mineral aggregates under wet grinding conditions. Its objective is to accurately determine aggregate quality by measuring the percentage loss after the sample is rotated with a stainless-steel abrasive charge and water for a specified duration or a specified number of revolutions
instruments.application: It is used to assess the resistance of aggregates to abrasion and wear under wet conditions

instruments.name: Cohesion Test
instruments.description: The cohesion tester is used to evaluate the development of set and early-age strength in slurry surfacing and microsurfacing. By measuring torque required to shear a prepared specimen at defined intervals, the device provides a quantitative indication of the mixture's ability to resist mechanical disturbance during the curing period.
instruments.application: It is used to evaluate the early strength and set time of microsurfacing mixes to determine when the surface can be opened to traffic

instruments.name: Light Weight Deflectometer
instruments.description: Light Weight Deflectometer is a portable device used to measure the elastic modulus of pavement layers and subgrades by applying a dynamic load through a falling mass. It provides rapid, non-destructive assessment of layer stiffness in the field
instruments.application: Field evaluation of subgrade and base stiffness for quality control and pavement design verification.

instruments.name: Dipstick Profiler
instruments.description: Dipstick Profiler is a precision digital level used to measure pavement surface profile, smoothness, and flatness. It provides high-accuracy elevation data for determining the International Roughness Index (IRI) and surface deviations
instruments.application: Measuring surface profiles, IRI, and longitudinal smoothness of pavement and concrete slabs.

instruments.name: Dynamic Cone Penetrometer
instruments.description: Dynamic Cone Penetrometer determines the in-situ strength of subgrade and granular layers by measuring the penetration per blow of a standard cone driven by a falling hammer.
instruments.application: Field estimation of subgrade and base strength and compaction quality control.

instruments.name: Non Nuclear Density Gauge
instruments.description: Non-Nuclear Density Gauge is a portable field device that determines the density of asphalt layers using dielectric properties instead of radiation sources. It provides a rapid and safe alternative to nuclear gauges.
instruments.application: Determining in-situ density for compaction control of asphalt layers

instruments.name: Benkelman Beam Deflection Test
instruments.description: Benkelman Beam is used to measure rebound deflection of flexible pavements under a standard wheel load. It provides an indication of the structural capacity and helps in overlay design
instruments.application: Evaluation of pavement deflection and structural condition for maintenance and overlay design.
